title: Edge-addition monotonicity of positive p-energy fails for every p >= 1
summary: At a 2021 AIM workshop, Guo conjectured that the positive square energy s+ = E+_2 should inherit the familiar edge-addition monotonicity of the spectral radius, rho(G + uv) >= rho(G). That conjecture was subsequently shown to fail at p = 2. Tang, Liu, and Wang then introduced positive p-energy, proved nonmonotonicity for every 1 = 3.
